description: A StationAPI mod for Minecraft Beta 1.7.3 that adds a purpose to your score!

mods.name: WhatAreYouScoring
mods.description: Adds a purpose to your score! Player score resets upon death in singleplayer and upon logout in multiplayer. Achievements are saved per instance and do not reset.
